name: ChartPNG: weekly KPI report to Slack

parameters.content:
**ChartPNG: weekly KPI report to Slack**

1. Open "Sample data" and replace the numbers with your own (a database, an API, another node). Keep the field names, or change "Build chart URLs" to match.
2. In "Post to Slack", pick your Slack credential and set the channel.
3. Run the workflow once, then publish it (Active on n8n 1.x).

The message holds two images: a KPI with a sparkline (preset kpi) and this week against last week (preset comparison). Slack loads each image from its URL, and an image URL can be at most 3000 characters, so keep the data short.

The URLs carry no key, so the images have a small watermark. Docs: https://chartpng.dev/guides/n8n
